_source: Hover cards for the action bar's close-quarters actions (Hud.action_help), like net_help.json for the NET panel. Short paraphrases of CPR core p.168-169, p.177, p.183-184 and p.180 (Put Out Fire) as distilled in docs/rules/combat.md sections 3, 5 and 7; hand-edited. Each entry: name, cost, text (what it does), key (its roll or numbers), page, book (default CPR core; SPM = Single Player Mode). Ids are Encounter.grapple_options().

grab.name: Grab
grab.text: Get hold of a foe in reach. While the grapple lasts you both take -2 to all Actions, they can't use their Move Action (yours drags them along) and neither of you can use a two-handed weapon. A long gun in hand is slung for a one-handed weapon.
grab.key: DEX + Brawling + 1d10 vs theirs, ties to them

choke.name: Choke
choke.text: Squeeze the one you hold: your BODY straight to their HP, armour ignored and not ablated. Someone above 1 HP it would put below 0 is left at 1 HP, Unconscious. Choked three Rounds running, they go out whatever their HP.

throw.name: Throw
throw.text: Throw the one you hold to the ground beside you: your BODY straight to their HP, armour ignored and not ablated. The grapple and its -2 end, and they are Prone until they Get Up.

shield.name: Human Shield
shield.text: Hold the one you grapple between you and the guns: they are cover against ranged attacks you can see, but not melee or Aimed Shots at your head. They can't dodge, and a shot into them hurts them normally. If they die you hold a corpse shield with HP equal to their BODY.
shield.key: cover · no dodge for the shield

release.name: Release
release.text: Let go: the grapple ends and so does its -2. Dropping a corpse shield takes an Action.

escape.name: Escape
escape.text: Break the hold on you. Win and the grapple is over: your Move Action is yours again if you haven't used it.
escape.key: DEX + Brawling + 1d10 vs the holder's, ties to them

break.name: Break Hold
break.text: Anyone can break a hold: step in beside whoever is holding your friend and pry them loose.
break.key: DEX + Brawling + 1d10 vs the holder's, ties to them

get_up.name: Get Up
get_up.text: Stand up from Prone. Until you do you have no Move Action; once up, your Move Action is back.

put_out.name: Put Out Fire
put_out.text: Beat out the flames. While you're On Fire you take its damage straight to HP at the end of every Turn, armor or not, until you spend an Action on this.

search_body.name: Search Body
search_body.text: Go through the pockets of someone down or surrendered beside you, once per body. Most carry nothing worth taking; a find is cash, gear, a keycard, a NET login code or a lead a fixer might follow up. It goes home with whoever found it.
search_body.key: 1d6 for anything (Mook 1-2, Lieutenant 1-3, Mini Boss 1-4), then 1d100 on the body's table

spoof.name: Spoof
spoof.text: Fool a camera or an alarm panel within 3 squares to win back time on the detection clock: a looped feed, a panel showing all clear. Success adds a die back (never above the clock's start) and the camera stops reporting. Failure is a failed Electronics/Security Tech check: the clock rolls. Once per clock a turn, each device once.
spoof.key: TECH + Electronics/Security Tech (+ Field Expertise) vs DV15
